title: Purification of Nosema bombycis Spores
author: Zhu Feng
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.if3cbqn

steps.title: Purify Nosema Spores
steps.instruction: Isolate and purify spores from infected beetles using homogenization and gradient centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize infected beetles in sterile water.
Filter the homogenates through four layers of cheesecloth.
Centrifuge the filtrate at 3000 g for 15 min.
Resuspend the resulting pellets in sterile water.
Purify spores via Percoll gradient centrifugation using 90% Percoll at 15,000 g for 40 min.
Collect the spore band and wash several times with sterile water.

steps.title: Prepare Spores for Electron Microscopy
steps.instruction: Fix and embed purified spores for ultrastructural analysis via transmission electron microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Fix purified spores overnight in 2.5% glutaraldehyde in 0.1 M cacodylate buffer (pH 7.4).
Post-fix samples for 3 h in 1% osmium tetroxide.
Dehydrate samples through an ascending ethanol series.
Embed the dehydrated samples in Epon–Araldite.
Cut ultrathin sections using a Reichert–Jung ULTRACUT E ultramicrotome.
Stain sections first in methanolic uranyl acetate and then in lead citrate.
